verdict.rationale: AngelList's help docs describe requesting a new 409A valuation in-platform: Equity > Valuations > Add > Request New Valuation, then completing a form. Nothing shows the valuation is audit-ready, built from live cap table data rather than form input, or refreshed on a recurring schedule; the documented request is a one-off action. Missing for 10: audit-ready/defensibility evidence, generation from live cap table data, scheduled or recurring refreshes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can order an audit-ready 409A valuation in-platform, generated from my live cap table data, and get refreshed valuations on schedule

citations.quote: navigate to Equity > Valuations, click Add, select Request New Valuation, and complete the form.
